stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[7].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

validation_rejects.statement: add rejects a duplicate id, a self-dependency, an unknown dependency, a malformed id and an out-of-range priority, with exit 1 and scheduler.json unchanged.

cycle_rejected.statement: An add that would close a dependency cycle is rejected and nothing is persisted.
must_include: reject any add that would create a cycle

order_priority_tiebreak.statement: The execution order lists dependencies before dependents and picks the higher priority first among available jobs.
must_include: topological order with priority as tiebreak

ready_recomputed.statement: On load a pending job whose depends_on are all done is ready; others stay pending.
must_include: ready when pending and all depends_on are done

failure_cascade.statement: fail marks the job failed and every transitive dependent cancelled; unrelated jobs are untouched.

run_next_highest.statement: run-next picks the highest-priority ready job and leaves it done, unblocking its dependents.
must_include: run-next takes the highest-priority ready job

ready_not_persisted.statement: scheduler.json never contains the status ready, even after status or report.

commands_exist.statement: The CLI accepts add, run-next, fail <id>, status and report and exits 0 on valid use.
must_include: commands: add, run-next, fail, status, report
